value.criterion: Use all three documents to assess the supplied candidate, distinguishing payment and receipt conditions, the opened-goods exception and the unresolved return-postage cost.
value.uncertainty: Return-postage payer and fee are unspecified: the claim that Linden always pays is unsupported, not established false. Opened sealed goods are explicitly excluded even with a receipt; public holidays do not count toward the dispatch period.
